evidence: The morphology and film thickness of the boron nitride films was characterised by means of optical interferometry. Phase content was examined by X-ray diffraction (XRD) wgrazing incidence method (GI), CuK a radiationxand micro-Raman spectroscopy (ls 785 nm). The density of the films was measured by an X-ray reflectometry method. The film composition was measured using electron spectroscopy for chemical analysis (ESCA).
